params.name: resource
params.description: Filter by resource type. Valid values include static_clusters, dynamic_active_clusters, static_listeners, dynamic_active_listeners, dynamic_route_configs, static_route_configs, and bootstrap.

params.name: name_regex
params.description: Filter resources by name using a regular expression pattern.

params.name: include_eds
params.description: Include EDS endpoint assignment data in the config dump.

items.docs: Returns the currently loaded Envoy configuration as a JSON object containing bootstrap, clusters, listeners, routes, secrets, and endpoints. Supports filtering by resource type and name regex to reduce output size.
